records.title: IDCF Cloud: disruption and encryption affecting 495 companies and municipalities.
records.confirmed: VM shutdown and encryption across 4 zones in East Japan Region 1. Backup retrieval confirmed possible for 206 customers. Unauthorized queries affected portal registration information for up to 71 companies, with up to 4 unauthorized password changes.
records.unknown: 206 is not the number of completed recoveries. The company says data inside VMs was not exfiltrated and traces of registration-information exfiltration remain unconfirmed. Final recovery dates for all customers and total losses are undisclosed.
records.response: Reset passwords. Support alternative-environment migration and backup retrieval.
records.as_of: Source updated: 2026-10-27 / Prior source context; text not revalidated in this update

records.title: infoQ: exfiltration of 89 ten-thousand and 4,082 records and unauthorized point exchanges
records.confirmed: Exfiltration of 894,082 personal information records confirmed. 611 unauthorized exchanges totaling 2,869,500 yen. Service suspended since 10/3, also affecting some commissioned surveys.
records.unknown: The initial maximum of 948,498 records is not a confirmed damage count. The vulnerability CVE, final recovery date, and total completed compensation remain unconfirmed in the text.
records.response: All member passwords invalidated. Policy is to fully reimburse fraudulently exchanged points. Change passwords on other services where the same password is used.
records.as_of: Source updated: 2026-10-14 / Prior source context; text not revalidated in this update

records.title: Onamae.com: business environment shutdown and data exfiltration
records.confirmed: Service stopped on 10/21 and external removal of customer data was confirmed. The offender-site domain was stopped around 04:00 on 10/28. Notice16 records 428 cumulative tips as of 10/30 at 18:00.
records.unknown: Authenticity of published content, victim counts, and total unauthorized transaction amounts remain undetermined. Domain suspension does not mean full recovery of information or service restoration.
records.response: At 15:30 on 10/30, GMO announced that direct contact about condolence-payment procedures and alternative services had begun. Starting contact does not establish completed payments or recovery for every customer.
records.as_of: Source updated: 2026-10-30 / Individual contact started; full recovery unconfirmed

records.title: @link: patient booking and related service suspension
records.confirmed: Suspended since late night on 10/14. Database information acquisition and personal information leakage from late September (month 9) to mid-October (month 10) were confirmed. Patient apps, web reservations, and other functions remained suspended as of the 28th at 12:30.
records.unknown: Leakage counts and the resumption date for all functions remain under investigation and verification. Starting beta testing at some medical institutions is not resumption of general availability.
records.response: Block intrusion paths and disable related credentials. Contact medical institutions directly to change reservations. Set a new password upon resumption.

records.title: Aiiku Hospital: vaccination and postpartum care reservations disrupted
records.confirmed: The Atlink suspension makes pediatric vaccination reservations, pediatric postpartum day care reservations, and consultation calling unavailable. Other web reservation systems remain available normally.
records.unknown: This announcement does not confirm a complete clinical shutdown or harm to life. It is a user-side impact of the Atlink incident, not an independent separate attack.
records.response: Check the hospital's alternative appointment guidance and contact the hospital directly about necessary procedures.
records.as_of: Source updated: 2026-10-23 / Prior source context; text not revalidated in this update

records.title: Railway: interrupted builds/deployments, suspended new registrations
records.confirmed: Build/deploy interruptions and dashboard/API/CLI/support outages occurred. The 10/29 15:45 UTC status still pauses signups with no reopening date, prioritizing existing-customer reliability.
records.unknown: The maximum 1.85%, about 100,000 workspaces, is the potential scope of environment-variable exposure, not a confirmed count of people affected by leakage. Key-revocation notifications alone do not confirm compromise.
records.response: Revoke and reissue stored secrets at their providers and audit GitHub and registries. The next status update is scheduled for 10/30 at 16:00 UTC, after this cutoff.
records.as_of: Source updated: 2026-10-29 / Signups remain paused; reopening date unknown

records.title: Piccoma: 100 ten-thousand and 2,404 recipient records leaked
records.confirmed: Confirmed leakage of email addresses for 1,002,404 recipients of 1 newsletter mailing. Newsletter suspended.
records.unknown: These are recipient counts, not global victim counts or counts across all Blastmail customers. Piccoma itself, passwords, and purchase information are described as unaffected, with normal use available.
records.response: Individual notifications, regulatory reports, and changes to sender authentication settings. Watch for impersonation emails.
records.as_of: Source updated: 2026-10-24 / Prior source context; text not revalidated in this update

records.title: Ministry of the Environment: related newsletter delivery/management suspended
records.confirmed: Delivery and management operations are unavailable for 6 related email newsletters. Management screens/API stopped at 10/21 00:30, and delivery stopped around 01:00.
records.unknown: Leakage of recipient information is unconfirmed. Do not generalize Piccoma's findings to the Ministry of the Environment. Affected counts are unspecified.
records.response: Confirm whether leakage occurred based on the operator's investigation. Resumption timing is stated as undetermined.
records.as_of: Source updated: 2026-10-23 / Prior source context; text not revalidated in this update

records.title: Studio: externally retrievable information and notification/key-rotation burdens.
records.confirmed: Intrusion from 9/30 to 10/1; data remained externally retrievable until 10/14. Decryption keys were also read, potentially revealing form contents, API keys, and other information.
records.unknown: Actual acquisition of information is unconfirmed. Affected counts and secondary harm are under investigation. Alteration/deletion is unconfirmed.
records.response: Fix paths and rotate keys. Revoke external API keys with their issuers. The 10/28 00:30 update schedules joint-report acceptance for early November (month 11); individual notification is separate.
records.as_of: Source updated: 2026-10-28 / Rechecked; full recovery remains unconfirmed

records.title: Yotsuya Medical Cube: leakage of old appointment data
records.confirmed: Unauthorized acquisition of reservation data through an intrusion on 9/21–22 into the former outsourced reservation system “Itsuaki.” Leakage of names, phone numbers, and email addresses confirmed.
records.unknown: Dates of birth, gender, and additional reservation fields remain under investigation. Counts are undisclosed. Impact on the current reservation system used since March (month 3) 2025 and electronic medical records, and secondary harm, are unconfirmed.
records.response: Fines is contacting affected individuals in sequence. The hospital requests authority reporting, recurrence prevention, and detailed investigation, and warns against opportunistic contacts.

records.response: Awaiting third-party validation as of 10/27 14:30 UTC. Keep affected connections disabled until individual guidance.

records.title: LiteLLM: malicious package distribution and environment rebuilding burden
records.confirmed: Malicious 1.107.0 and containers were actually distributed on 10/21, confirming compromise of release infrastructure.
records.unknown: Key leakage affecting all users, affected organization counts, and total theft are undisclosed. Do not reuse damage statistics from the separate incident in March (month 3).
records.response: Investigate affected installations, isolate and rebuild environments. Revoke and reissue keys that were reachable. Check the risk of startup hooks executing again before performing a simple update.

records.title: Fireblocks mpc-lib: key-share hierarchy risks; actual theft unconfirmed
records.confirmed: CERT disclosed an issue potentially allowing access from a descendant share and chain code to an ancestor/root share of the same party.
records.unknown: The materials do not state actual asset theft or affected customer counts. They do not establish that a transfer key independently meeting the threshold can be obtained.
records.response: No fixed version is available. Protect chain codes as secrets and investigate the entire key-share hierarchy.

records.title: So-net: member information and some email passwords exposed
records.confirmed: Disclosure of 2,141,986 So-net member records and 443,495 plala (S course) member records. Email passwords in some mail services were also exposed and reset. Bank-account information: 16 records; notification information: 7 records.
records.unknown: Categories may overlap; do not add them as a count of people. Root cause and total losses remain undetermined. Distinguish member-account passwords from the affected email passwords.
records.response: Reset affected email passwords using official guidance and change reused passwords. Avoid links in unsolicited incident-related email.
records.as_of: Source updated: 2026-10-27 / Prior source context; text not revalidated in this update

records.title: UNM Health: clinical and academic recovery, with a warning about follow-on scams
records.confirmed: Ambulance diversion, interrupted outpatient surgery and appointments, and suspended classes on 10/26. The official 10/28 update confirms fully functional clinical services and resumed classes and research.
records.unknown: Disclosure counts and losses remain undetermined. The institution describes impact on some devices and denies penetration of core systems. Attacker claims are not confirmed disclosure.
records.response: Reschedule interrupted care through official channels. Do not engage with purported attackers or compensation offers.
records.as_of: Source updated: 2026-10-28 / Prior source context; text not revalidated in this update

records.response: Update kernels and embedded products, verify running versions, and investigate credentials and management infrastructure where compromise is suspected.
